verdict: Ads are returning $5.44 for every $1 spent, with purchases up 30%.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, your Meta ads generated $7,438.90 in revenue on $1,368.38 in spend, a 5.44x return, and purchases rose 30% in the most recent 7-day window compared to the prior 7 days. Short-term purchase momentum leveled off in the last three days, so we're watching the trend closely heading into November. Several foundational build items — including conversion tracking, subscribe pages, and automated flows — are overdue and are now the active priority; completing these will give us a fuller picture of what's driving sales and unlock the next phase of scaling. Expect those pieces to close out around the October 31 milestone, with a full monthly review and scale discussion happening at the same time.

watch_item.issue: Conversion tracking is not yet live, so purchase attribution relies on a single data source and may under-report the full picture.
